policies.name: Privacy Policy
policies.summary: Understand what information is used, why it is needed and how to contact our privacy grievance officer.

policies.name: Website Terms of Use
policies.summary: The terms for reading, sharing and using our public website, distinct from booking or paying for care.

policies.name: Service Terms
policies.summary: Understand enquiries, informed choices, service arrangements and the terms to confirm before booking.

policies.name: Cookie & Website Technology Policy
policies.summary: How managed pages use optional analytics preferences, technical services and browser storage.

policies.name: Copyright & Intellectual Property
policies.summary: Use sources accurately, respect ownership and licences, and report an intellectual-property concern.

policies.name: Children, Guardians & Account Eligibility
policies.summary: Separate a child’s service needs from the adult responsible for enquiries, consent and accounts.

policies.name: Contact & Grievance Information
policies.summary: One place for family guidance, booking questions, billing, privacy and other concerns.

policies.name: Information, Care & Liability Boundaries
policies.summary: What website information, software licences and evidence establish—and what requires individual professional judgment.

policies.name: Reviews, Testimonials & Publication Consent
policies.summary: Honest feedback and a separate, voluntary choice about publishing identifiable stories or images.

policies.name: Applicable Law & Dispute Resolution
policies.summary: Indian law, a practical concern route and preservation of statutory complaint and forum rights.

policies.name: External Services & Third-Party Integration
policies.summary: Understand external maps, platforms, hosting, measurement and payment or account destinations.

policies.name: Refund & Cancellation Policy
policies.summary: Check the booking conditions before payment and request review of a cancellation, unused service or billing error.

policies.name: Staff Conduct & Care Standards
policies.summary: The conduct expected of our people: child dignity, truthful records, confidentiality and accountable care.

policies.name: Ethics Charter
policies.summary: The commitments that keep the child, family and whole-life purpose central to our decisions.

policies.name: Payment & Billing
policies.summary: Understand charges, payment confirmation and billing review before making a payment.
